6. 
```{r}
Makes new column in mtcars dataset that distinguishes if a car is fuel efficient or not

view(mtcars)
for (car in mtcars) {
  if (car$mpg > 20) {
    mtcars$fuelEfficient[car] = "Yes"
   else {
    mtcars$fuelEfficient = "No"
  }
  print(mtcars$fuelefficient)
}
```

7.create a facet wrap graph to generate a scatterplot of mpg and hp based on the number of cylinders a car has
```{r}
(mtcars)
ggplot(mtcars,aes(mpg,hp,color,(gear))) + geom_point() + theme_minimal() + facet_wrap(gear) 
```

13. Create and save a function that divides all numbers in a column by 10. Test it on the starwars mass column.
```{r}
divByTen<- function(number){number/10}
starwars$mass<- divByTen
```
